results.content: # Alphas, Beta, Gammas, Omegas, Sigmas | Modern Identities. ## Modern Identities. Celebrating our relationships with self and others. But is it all just nonsense? Press enter or click to view image in full size. Image 4: Three guys in swimming trunks sitting on white plinths, looking out onto an aqua sea on a sunny day. T he Greek Alphabet (alpha, beta, gamma) has many uses, but is the identification and labelling of male personality types one of them? We all know the top two, but let’s remind ourselves of them and get to know the others. A macho man, but aggressive with it. Can be clingy in relationships. Self-reliant, prefers to remain independent of social groups or hierarchies. Driven and intelligent but has little impulse to compete or conform. ## Create an account to read the full story.
